original_test_intent: Validate Standard-RAS ADDDC sparing with plus1 enabled on the approved 64 GB x4 DIMM topology, demonstrating a successful harasser run, correctable slot attribution, indicators remaining off and normal system operation.
original_method: A qualified operator installs the approved DIMMs and an FAE configures Standard-RAS ADDDC plus1 with a fully resolved package recipe. The operator runs one bounded harasser sequence while the agent validates captured configuration and collects Cscript, Windows, BMC, UEFI and health evidence before restoration.
manual_activity: The operator handles ESD-safe DIMM installation, BIOS/ADDDC plus1 configuration, harasser execution, indicators and restoration. The agent may validate and correlate read-only evidence, making this a hybrid rather than a wholly manual test.
required_inputs: Approved 64 GB x4 DIMM PN/revision, slots/ranks and trained-capacity map
Intel ITP/CScripts build/hash and DeviceSparingHarasser parameter semantics
Explicit Standard-RAS ADDDC/adddcType and plus1-enabled value, runTime and socket/mc/ch coverage
Expected `sparing_harasser PASSED`, correctable slot, indicator-off and normal-operation oracle
ESD/power, backup, abort, recovery and hardware/BIOS restoration plan
safety_requirements: Qualified hardware operator with ESD/power controls, stable power and independent console
Verify physical population and trained topology before enabling ADDDC plus1
Run only one fully resolved plus1 recipe with self-check enabled
Abort on wrong topology/plus1 state, self-check failure, UCE, fault indication, crash or health degradation
No automatic retry; restore DIMMs/settings and verify memory health
agent_execution_scope: Validate inventory, plus1/target captures and collect read-only Cscript, Windows, BMC, UEFI and health evidence
Do not install DIMMs, change BIOS/ADDDC/plus1, choose parameters, inject/retry or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve DIMM topology and exact plus1-enabled recipe/coverage
Define device-sparing success and expected correctable slot mapping
Specify indicator-off and measurable normal-operation criteria

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture physical/trained topology and exact plus1 state, execute one resolved harasser with full transcript, time-correlate the sparing transition and correctable slot records with a health workload and off indicators, then restore/diff all hardware and BIOS state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes plus1 selection and the normal-operation assertion independently auditable without changing the requested ADDDC variant.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Corrected-error keywords alone cannot distinguish the plus1 path from no-plus1 or prove device sparing and continued health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong plus1/adddcType or topology can exercise the wrong redundancy mode, produce an UCE, crash Windows or leave unexpected capacity/state.
